svg.title: Android remote management mockups: Manage device for a repeater over the mesh, no answer from a device, the Radio category with edits, leaving with changes, the mesh warning before a radio change, the Identity category waiting with a rejected value, Repeater, Power, entering DFU mode, and Manage device for the companion radio on a tablet

svg.text: spinner with Cancel while asking, or the problem with a

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: close button. A device answers only its administrators,
